clearedSpotChecks.check: L-1262: in the 237 blocks with two or more PoolManager transactions (blocks 47,069,954 to 52,388,737), are the producer's receipts those of an execution that resets transient storage between transactions?
clearedSpotChecks.note: Rechecked two blocks myself on https://rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm and https://rpc.hyperlend.finance/archive on 2026-11-27. Block 47,069,954 has hash prefix 0xa35e924cd8cbc74a and receiptsRoot prefix 0x34af6520e36609f3 on both; the official endpoint serves 3 receipts and the archive 5, the 2 extra having gasUsed 0 (system transactions), and the 3 shared receipts match in status, gasUsed and log count. Block 49,161,462 has equal hash and receiptsRoot on both; the reverted transaction (status 0, gasUsed 0x848e3, no logs) is the last of the block, as the cleared item says. The unit's own l1262.json shows only 162 of 237 blocks with whole receipt lists equal; l1262b.json explains the rest by the 113 omitted system receipts and finds 1,864 of 1,864 served receipts equal. The lock and delta count live in transient storage (src/libraries/Lock.sol:13-25, src/libraries/NonzeroDeltaCount.sol:14-32) and unlock reverts on a nonzero count before relocking (src/PoolManager.sol:105-113), so a leak would need a reset fault, which the receipt data does not show. I did not read the nanoreth source that refuses a block with a mismatched receipts root; the conclusion stands on direct receipt equality without it.
